series.title: Trump grid order likely to cause energy storage delays, cancellations: BloombergNEF
series.summary: The Aug. 26 executive order, previous executive actions and the Treasury Department’s foreign entity of concern guidance are likely to hit battery and inverter supply chains particularly hard, an industry analyst told Utility Dive.

series.title: Italy gives national strategic interest designation to Sardinia data centre with hybrid energy storage hub
series.summary: The Italian government has declared an AI data centre in development by Energy Vault, featuring hybrid energy storage technologies, to be of strategic national interest.

series.title: BW ESS starts building 515MWh Italy BESS; buys 675MWh projects in Spain
series.summary: BESS owner-operator BW ESS has progressed large-scale projects in Italy and Spain, totalling almost 1.2GWh and set to come online in 2027/28.

series.title: Canadian Solar ships 3.7GWh of BESS in Q2 2026, company is ‘actively validating’ 15,000+ cycle sodium-ion product
series.summary: Canadian Solar’s quarterly battery storage shipments increased 73% year-on-year, with 3.7GWh delivered in the second quarter of 2026.

series.title: Hyperstrong starts building LEAG’s 1.6GWh Germany BESS under turnkey contract
series.summary: Power generator LEAG and its turnkey BESS construction partner HyperStrong have started building a 400MW/1,600MWh project in Germany, while Sunotec has done the same on a 441MWh project.

series.title: ONE Nuclear Energy executes LOI for 2.88GWh BESS and gas plant co-located with Louisiana data centre
series.summary: ONE Nuclear Energy has executed a binding letter of intent to develop a 2.88GW natural gas plant and 700MW/2.88GWh energy storage system, co-located with a high-capacity data centre campus.

series.title: Fervo-Google geothermal deal underscores baseload power scarcity, analysts say
series.summary: Key risks remain, however, including “first-of-a-kind execution,” interconnection bottlenecks, capital intensity and competing technology paths, according to a research note from financial services company William Blair.

series.title: Transmission expansion could spur billions in savings, especially in PJM: study
series.summary: About a dozen inter- and intraregional projects in the Eastern Interconnection could help meet load growth, lower retail electric rates, bolster reliability and support U.S. security, the study found.

series.title: PG&E sees rising interest in ‘customer-driven’ flexible interconnection pilot
series.summary: The Flex Connect program allows larger distribution-connected loads to energize in months instead of waiting “several years” for firm interconnection, the Northern California utility says.

series.title: Synergy fined AU$1.2 million over Kwinana battery software error that inflated wholesale prices in Western Australia
series.summary: Western Australia's ERA has fined state-owned energy company Synergy AU$1.2 million (US$785,600) after a software error at the Kwinana BESS.

series.title: Amazon signs first Asia Pacific standalone battery storage tolling deal for 50MW BESS in Australia
series.summary: Anza Power has signed a tolling agreement with Amazon Australia for the 50MW/200MWh Bairnsdale BESS in East Gippsland, Victoria.

series.title: Climate groups slam Germany’s ‘pro-gas’ capacity market design as European Commission grants state aid approval
series.summary: The European Commission’s late approval of Germany’s capacity market auctions leaves no room for public scrutiny, according to environmental law charity ClientEarth.

series.title: Google partners with MN8 Energy and Eos on West Virginia solar-plus-LDES project
series.summary: Developer-operator MN8 Energy, zinc hybrid cathode battery and storage system maker Eos Energy Enterprises, and tech giant Google are backing a multi-technology renewables project on the PJM grid in the US.

series.title: Engie starts up 251MW BESS projects in Chile, Grenergy sells fourth phase of Atacama solar-plus-storage complex
series.summary: Power firm Engie and IPP Grenergy are advancing three solar-plus-BESS projects in Chile.

series.title: Inertia in Germany is ‘first bankable long-term revenue stream,’ could boost battery storage IRR by 1-2pp
series.summary: Inertia could provide a strong boost to BESS project returns in Germany, but operators are still waiting for the first prequalified inverters.

series.title: Land-based wind power pipeline shrinks as price gap with solar widens
series.summary: John Hensley, senior vice president of markets and policy analysis at ACP, told Utility Dive that his organization has calculated at least 44 GW of wind projects are “stuck” in review at the U.S. Department of Defense.

series.title: China’s half-year energy storage deployments post first-ever decline to 22GW/59GWh, while overseas orders surge 83%
series.summary: CNESA's report is a comprehensive overview of China’s energy storage sector in H1 2026 and outlines the industry outlook under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

series.title: Energy Vault secures full land ownership for 1GWh Stoney Creek BESS in Australia
series.summary: Energy Vault has completed the acquisition of the underlying project land for its 125MW/1,000MWh Stoney Creek battery energy storage system (BESS) in northern New South Wales, Australia.

series.title: Under the hood: Inside Tesla’s Megapack 3 as Texas production begins
series.summary: Tesla was one of the pioneers of the grid-scale battery storage market, but has faced increasing competition in the past few years. In this article we look under the hood of its latest grid-scale BESS product, the Megapack 3.

series.title: BESS Industry Buzz: German grid attack, revenue cannibilisation, CATL’s price cut, sodium-ion’s ramp-up and more
series.summary: A roundup of user-posted analysis, views and unofficial news from across the industry this past week, this time looking at this week's sabotage attack on the German grid, BESS revenues and electricity market activity, CATL's LFP price cut and various non-lithium news.

series.title: Equinor’s East Point Energy begins operations at 200MWh Texas BESS
series.summary: East Point Energy, owned by Norwegian state-owned energy company Equinor has completed construction and started operations at the 100MW/200MWh Citrus Flatts energy storage project in Harlingen, Texas, US.

series.title: OptiGrid to optimise Vena Energy’s 408MW Bellambi Heights BESS in Australia
series.summary: OptiGrid has been selected by Vena Energy to provide trading optimisation services for the 408MW Bellambi Heights BESS in Australia.

series.title: EDF Power Solutions Australia seeks EPBC Act approval for 4GWh pumped hydro plant
series.summary: EDF Power Solutions Australia has referred the Wala Wala Pumped Hydro Energy Storage project, a 300-400MW facility in NSW.

series.title: Macquarie-backed Blueleaf Energy and Universal Peak close financing on Malaysia tender-winning BESS project
series.summary: Blueleaf Energy and Universal Peak have closed financing for a 100MW/400MWh battery storage project, which was one of four winning bids in a Malaysian government tender.

series.title: Mongolia completes first renewable energy auction
series.summary: The auction procured 220 MW of solar and 135 MW/440 MWh of battery energy storage across five projects. A second auction, covering renewable energy projects with a stabilisation solution in Mongolia’s Gobi region, is scheduled to take place on September 11. series.title: Pakistan’s regulator approves mandatory energy storage component for renewables auction
series.summary: Pakistan's National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) has approved plans to require bidders in a renewable energy auction to include energy storage.

series.title: Uzbekistan has now 2.5 GW of solar under net metering
series.summary: Uzbekistan added 509.7 MW of PV capacity under its Solar House net metering scheme in the first eight months of 2026. The post Uzbekistan has now 2.5 GW of solar under net metering appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.summary: Recovering silicon from Europe's end-of-life solar panels won't meaningfully cut import reliance unless the region's ingot and wafer manufacturing base grows to absorb it, a SINTEF Industry researcher tells pv magazine. series.title: Zambia’s PV capacity tops 841 MW
series.summary: Zambia’s installed solar PV capacity has surged from 88 MW in 2021 to approximately 841 MW in 2026, including around 584 MW of identified utility-scale projects and 30 MW under net metering. The post Zambia’s PV capacity tops 841 MW appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Serbian utility looks to acquire, jointly develop renewable energy projects
series.summary: The call to acquire or jointly develop renewable energy projects includes solar PV plants larger than 50 MW that can be connected to Serbia's transmission system. The post Serbian utility looks to acquire, jointly develop renewable energy projects appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: India tenders 700 MW of solar capacity for C&I offtake
series.summary: Solar Energy Corp. of India (SECI) has launched a tender for 700 MW of interstate transmission system (ISTS)-connected solar PV projects in special economic zones (SEZs) or areas designated as export-oriented units (EOUs) in India, with the electricity earmarked for a commercial and industrial (C&I) consumer in Odis…

series.title: Latvia expands residential solar and battery rebate scheme
series.summary: Latvia has expanded its €85 million household renewable energy support program, raising grants for eligible households and increasing the minimum supported battery capacity from 5 kWh to 10 kWh. The scheme had supported 15,700 projects as of May 2026, including more than 14,000 applications for solar PV and over 2,0…

series.title: Nigeria tenders 100 MW solar project
series.summary: A tender is open in Nigeria advertising the construction and installation of a 100 MW solar project to be built in the country’s central Niger state. The deadline for prequalification is October 13. The post Nigeria tenders 100 MW solar project appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Italy deploys 2.61 GW of solar in H1
series.summary: Italy added 2.9 GW of renewable energy capacity in the first half of 2026, with solar accounting for 2.6 GW. Cumulative PV capacity reached approximately 46.8 GW at the end of June. The post Italy deploys 2.61 GW of solar in H1 appeared first on pv magazine Global .
